description: Read the full free answer for a route ID returned by find_evidence_questions or find_package_advisories. Optional version is an exact explicit-list check for advisory records only; ranges are unresolved and a missing version never means safe. Includes public evidence, review dates, source URLs, exclusions and snapshot hash. Seven public evidence packs return complete comparisons and bindings free. The integration-kit route returns free evidence, scope, schema and worked-example links; its executable is privately delivered using an existing paid offer or one eligible subscription query. snapshot_sha256 binds the full delivery; preview_payload_sha256 separately binds the kit preview. Unknown routes are refused. This does not save a paid delivery, run a new test or verify current deployment applicability. No key or payment is needed.
name: preview_evidence_answer
title: Preview a complete evidence answer
